units.title: Finding aid
units.text: A structured description of an archival collection that explains its scope, arrangement and contents so researchers can identify relevant boxes or folders before requesting material.

units.title: Suspected mould
units.text: A box with suspected active mould is isolated from the reading room and normal storage. A conservator examines it before any material is returned to the collection area.

units.title: Digitization capture
units.text: The imaging technician captures a colour target and scale at the start of each digitization batch, then checks focus and exposure before continuing with the documents.

units.title: Clean hands for paper records
units.text: Clean, dry hands are preferred for ordinary paper documents. Cotton gloves reduce fingertip sensitivity and can catch fragile edges, so they are reserved for materials that specifically require them.

units.title: Cold storage acclimatization
units.text: Photographic material removed from cold storage remains sealed while it warms to room temperature. Opening the package too early can allow condensation to form on the object.
